intructions.title: How to play
intructions.body_1: Herd your sheep to safety by matching their leotards
intructions.body_2: Use your arrow keys to guide the falling flock
intructions.body_3: Don't stack sheep higher than the bunting!
intructions.body_4: Complete each level by herding as many sheep away as you can

level_complete_screen.title: LEVEL COMPLETE!
level_complete_screen.not_signed_in: to save your scores and win achievements!

level_fail_screen.title: SHEEP OVERLOAD!
level_fail_screen.body1: The sheep piled up too high! Try to keep them below the bunting.

hint0.title: TOP TIP
hint0.body: Drop all 6 of your sheep safely to the ground to complete the level

hint1.title: TOP TIP
hint1.body: Steer the sheep in the air so they land on the same colour as themselves

hint2.title: TOP TIP
hint2.body: Drop all your sheep to the ground to complete the level

hint3.title: MIND THE BUNTING
hint3.body: Don't let sheep pile up higher than this line!

hint4.title: TOP TIP
hint4.body: Some levels have obstacles that will get in your way

hint5.title: WILDCARD SHEEP
hint5.body: These can act as any colour, use them to finish off a combination

hint6.title: THE BLACK SHEEP
hint6.body: These clear the WHOLE board of the colour they land on first

hint7.title: MOVING OBSTACLES
hint7.body: Watch out for obstacles that move
